name: paracoding
description: An agent platform that installs into your own Google Cloud project -- your project, your bill, your key. Agents act under server-resolved roles with per-key tool classes, and every privileged job is KMS-signed and journalled. install.sh ships PC_AUTO_APPROVE=1, so a job an agent stages is signed and executed in the same call; set PC_AUTO_APPROVE=0 and it stops for a human instead.
